content:
maria: Thanks everyone for joining the Q&A — quick follow-up thread on the customer wins/losses discussion. I want to capture the top signals and next steps in one place.

alex: Quick summary from my side: biggest wins = reliability + predictable costs for infra teams; biggest losses = missing SSO + weird latency spikes on bursts.

sarah: +1 re: SSO. A large financial prospect told us 'can't go forward without SSO and SCIM' during the pilot.

tom: Noted. We should prioritize a lightweight SCIM/oauth MVP for Dedicated/Private — not full IdP federations yet, but enough for evals.

maria: Action: create a short tracker for asks + owners. I'll start the spreadsheet and tag owners. Link after I post it.

james: For the latency spikes: can we share the specific query patterns? some customers send long-system prompts repeatedly which breaks our batching model.

alex: Good call. Eng to look at prefix-caching heuristics + smaller max-batch sizes for 'low-latency' lanes. Proposed owners: @alex (product) + @sarah (cs) + @eng-oncall (ops-bot).

ops-bot: poll created: "Which customer ask should be highest priority?" options: SSO/SCIM, Latency microbursts, Better quantization docs. Vote: /poll 1-3

sarah: We lost one deal because our Dedicated pricing model looked unpredictable at scale. Customer wanted fixed per-concurrent-token SLA.

tom: Pricing note — we can offer committed-concurrency pilots for mid-market to improve predictability. Product + RevOps to draft pilot program.

maria: Here's the tracker template (CSV snippet) I'm dropping into the drive for us to use:```
owner,ask,customer-count,priority,next-step,due
alex,SSO/SCIM,3,H,scim-mvp-spec,2026-05-15
alex,Latency microbursts,4,M,investigate-batching,2026-04-30
product-docs,Quantization docs,8,L,doc-first-pass,2026-05-08
```

alex: I'll own the SSO/SCIM spec. Can we get a 3-week target for an internal demo?

maria: Sounds good. @alex set the milestone and I'll sync CS for customers to invite to the pilot.

sarah: Also request from enterprise: better per-route observability (token-level cost breakdown in console). That's top ask #2 from SEs.

tom: Observability is strategic — ops + product to propose a phased roadmap (console UI + API access). Put that in the tracker.

james: Small ask: can we add a checkbox for 'regression risk' so Research/evals can pre-clear changes that might drop quality?

maria: Good idea. I'll add a 'regression-risk' column.

ops-bot: reminder: deploy scheduled 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC (non-prod).

alex: Next concretes: I'll publish the SCIM spec draft by 1778902000, set milestone; eng to investigate microburst mitigation next sprint.

maria: If anyone has direct customer quotes or RFCs, drop them in the tracker or DM me. Thanks — will circle back with the drive link and a short prioritized list tomorrow. :thumbsup:
